journal_lines: Black seam in the stone. Wide and consistent.
Coal faces the whole tunnel. Good start.
Charcoal smell before I found it. Then the vein.
Coal running floor to ceiling on one face. Good exposure.
Struck through the calcite and found the seam behind it.
The vein angled down and widened as it went. Followed.
Soft rock crumbling around a dense coal face.
The torch burned coal-smell. Close now.
Scattered nodules first, then the main body.
Two seams parallel, two hand-widths apart.
The whole face from here to there. A lot of it.
Coal pitch in the joint. Followed the joint.
Dusty extraction. The result was worth it.
Took two hours to clear the face. Filled the bag twice over.
